fields.Name: T287 - File Browser Multi-Provider Search Panel
fields.Description: Exercises FileGridComponent's multi-account search UI (toggleMultiAccountSearchMode, selectedSearchProviders, executeMultiAccountSearch → GraphQL SearchFiles) — a distinct cross-provider search feature with provider-capability gating, separate from the local name filter and from any entity search.

InputDefinition.goal: In the File Browser (open via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, then 'Browse Files'), click the 'Search across all storage providers' button (magnifying-glass icon next to the file search bar). Success is seeing a 'Search Across Providers' panel open that contains a search-term input, a Search button, and a list of selectable storage accounts (checkboxes; some may be labeled '(no search)' when unsupported). Then close the panel via its close/toggle control. You do NOT need to run an actual cross-provider search. If no storage account exists, the 'No storage accounts configured' state is an acceptable pass. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking the multi-provider search button opens a 'Search Across Providers' panel with a search-term input, a Search button, and account-selection checkboxes
The panel can be closed again via its close/toggle control returning to the normal file listing — OR a clear 'No storage accounts configured' empty state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
